Search the data to see how they have changed in your area Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australia’s property market is facing a rare price correction, as rising interest rates and less favourable tax settings for investors accelerate a downturn. Most capital cities recorded winter price falls, according to Cotality data, with Sydney leading the decline. That weakness is expected to continue, as higher inflation could lead to further interest rate hikes , denting demand. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Nick Evershed and Jonathan Barrett

item.title: "Nuevo informe del ciberataque a Hugging Face por agentes de OpeanAI": 'Le Grand Continent'
item.description: Un nuevo informe independiente sobre el ataque informático cometido por agentes de inteligencia artificial a la plataforma Hugging Face revela que tuvo un alcance mayor del que se había informado inicialmente, según reportó 'Le Grand Continent'. Con agentes que, incluso, consideraron racional "sacrificarse" por el bien colectivo. Entretanto, la construcción de centros de datos se ha convertido en una nueva preocupación en Australia. La cadena británica 'BBC' informa que hay resistencia a la construcción de nuevos centros por el impacto medioambiental y en la vida diaria de quienes están cerca… Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Scientists reveal 7 countries most likely to survive a global collapse by maintaining society and food production
item.description: In an intriguing analysis, two studies have spotlighted seven island nations poised to withstand global calamities. New Zealand emerges as the frontrunner, lauded for its geographic isolation and abundant local resources. Australia, on the other hand, shines in nuclear winter scenarios, showcasing its vast food production potential. Both countries, however, grapple with import dependency for vital supplies, indicating distinct variations in their readiness based on various global crisis models. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Moveable feast: myna birds on Sydney train looking for food not ‘joyride’ in viral video
item.description: Mynas are ‘incredibly good learners’ and likely hopped on the inner-city train to scrounge, expert says Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A viral video of common myna birds appearing to calmly ride a Sydney train in place of winged flight has shocked social media users. But not experts, who say it makes perfect sense that avian life has adapted to routinely navigate public transport. Bird life is ubiquitous in Australia’s urban landscapes. They appear in our shopping centres, our workplaces, our homes. To witness a feathered friend on a train isn’t exceptional… Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.
